card.name: Point before 'even if' or 'despite'
card.fires_on: The comma, 'even', or a verb like 'persist' or 'occur' right where a concessive phrase such as 'even if' or 'despite' is expected next. It appears in label instructions and warnings.

modes.label: Comma before even if
modes.description: A comma ending a main instruction, just before 'even if' clauses.
modes.example: Continue treatment for the full 7 days<<,>> even if there is improvement.

modes.label: Verb before despite or even if
modes.description: A verb such as 'persist' or 'occur' that is followed by 'despite' or 'even if'.
modes.example: Serious adverse reactions may still<< occur>> even if

modes.label: Word 'even' itself
modes.description: The word 'even' just before 'if', continuing a concession.
modes.example: exactly one week after the previous one was removed<< even>> if menstrual bleeding

card.writes: It suppresses 'regardless' and 'irrespective' words, so it steers away from that wording when a concession is coming.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning where 'even if' or 'despite' is about to follow.
